notes: This book is about Fletcher the fox who worries as his favourite tree loses its leaves in autumn, but is reassured when he sees the tree transformed by frost and ice into something beautiful in winter. Key emotional vocabulary (worried, cold) and seasonal/nature vocabulary (leaf, frost, ice, sparkle, winter) are central to retelling and discussing the story. 'Fall' has been flagged as ambiguous — boards may prefer to label this cell 'autumn' to avoid confusion with the falling-leaves action.
